determine_shape_based_on_query :: t0 -> t0 -> list(tclevrobject) -> t0

(lambda (lambda (lambda (clevr_if (clevr_eq_shape (clevr_query_shape (clevr_car $0)) clevr_cylinder) $1 $2))))
description: Determines a value based on whether the shape of the first object in the list matches a specified shape.

determine_shape_based_on_material_count :: list(tclevrobject) -> tclevrshape

(lambda (clevr_if (clevr_eq_material (clevr_if (clevr_gt? (clevr_count $0) 7) (clevr_query_material (clevr_car $0)) clevr_rubber) clevr_metal) clevr_sphere clevr_cylinder))
description: Determines the shape of an object based on the material count of the objects in the list. If the material count is greater than 7, it compares the material of the first object in the list with 'metal' and returns 'sphere' if they match, otherwise returns 'cylinder'. If the material count is not greater than 7, it compares the material of the first object with 'rubber' and returns 'sphere' if they match, otherwise returns 'cylinder'.
